title: Mari server-side authorization gate described as current (removed in v2.4.6)
skill_evidence: SKILL.md:122 "a server-side gate that lets her change data only when the user explicitly asked for that edit (2.4.3), with Keep/Restore review cards as the second line"; SKILL.md:153 "Independently, a server-side gate (2.4.3) lets her change data only when the active request explicitly asked for that edit". Contradicts references/architecture.md:111 (gate #5093 removed in v2.4.6, #5721). references/character-cards.md:243 does not mention a gate.
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:1273 (2.4.6, #5721): "the server-side authorization gate added after #4838 ... is removed. An intent-authorized edit now lands directly in the existing Keep/Restore review card"; #4838 intent-keyed read-only guidance and the ask-first Accept hold (#5748/#5820) remain. engine-v2.5.0 packages/server/src has no authorization-excerpt/gate code (grep empty); docs/home/professor-mari.md:78-100 lists only review cards plus sensitive-file and dependency approvals.
fix: SKILL.md:122 and :153: stop presenting the 2.4.3 gate as a current safeguard. Say that since v2.4.6 (#5721) an intent-phrased edit is applied straight into a Keep/Restore card, a how-do-I question is answered rather than performed (#4838), and once she asks, later edits wait behind Accept / Don't apply (#5748/#5820). Keep the 'phrase a build request as an instruction' tip, but credit #4838 intent keying for it. Add '(changed in v2.4.6; earlier guidance described a 2.4.3 server-side authorization gate)'.

title: Bulk tag editing missing from Library organization
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:321 "**Bulk select, export, and delete** for operating on many cards at once." (no bulk tag edit anywhere in the file)
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:328 (2.5.0, #6698) "preview adding or removing tags across selected cards"; :315/:322/:324: bulk tag edits include selected cards hidden by search or pagination, failed cards stay selected for retry, and tags and version history are preserved. en.json:109-128 has 'Edit tags of the selected characters' (short label 'Tags'), 'Add tags', 'Remove tags (tap to mark)' and 'Rename tags'. The 'Possible duplicates' comparison from #6698 was removed before release (CHANGELOG:116), so it should not be added.
fix: Library organization: change the bullet to '**Bulk select** → Export, Delete, or **Tags** (v2.5.0, #6698): add, remove or rename tags across the selection with a preview. It covers selected cards hidden by search or paging, and failed cards stay selected for retry.' Flag it as the clean-up step after a SillyTavern bulk import.

title: Generated images auto-fill card Galleries; switch to disable not mentioned
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:368 "> **Two galleries, one word.** ... distinguishes the **card-level Gallery** from a **chat's gallery**." (does not say generated images are copied into card Galleries, and does not name the switch)
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:394 (2.5.0, #6752): "Generation Settings can disable automatic character/persona gallery entries while keeping illustrations and selfies in chat." en.json:2777 has the label 'Automatically save generated images to character galleries'; its help (en.json:2776) reads 'Adds generated chat illustrations and selfies to the depicted characters' and personas' galleries. Turn off to keep them only in the chat gallery.' It defaults to true (packages/client/src/stores/ui.store.ts:1952; server image-generation-settings.ts:81 '!== false').
fix: Extend the Two galleries note: by default, generated chat illustrations and selfies are also saved to the depicted characters' and personas' card Galleries. Turn off **Automatically save generated images to character galleries** in Generation settings (v2.5.0, #6752) to keep them only in the chat gallery. Explicit gallery saves still work.

title: Mari review card details (Easy Viewer, per-entry Reject, View as prompt, 14-day auto-close) absent from approval-model section
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:243 "She **applies** a change and then shows a **Review Mari's changes** card with **Keep** / **Restore** ...". No Easy Viewer, Reject, View as prompt or retention. These are covered only in references/architecture.md:111, partially (Easy Viewer and 14 days).
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:1653 (2.4.2, #4919): Easy Viewer before/after diff, an Easy/Raw toggle per card, and per-change Dismiss. :1646 (#4931): per-entry Reject for lorebook entries; en.json:6016-6017 'Reject' / 'Revert just this entry. The rest of the change stays applied.' :1647 (#4931): 'View as prompt' for character and preset edits (en.json:6030), a synthetic preview. :1690 (#4828): cards survive restarts. docs/home/professor-mari.md:91: a card stays up to 14 days, then closes and the change stays. :93 (#6842): an edit that changes nothing gets no card.
fix: Add one sentence to character-cards.md:243. The card shows an Easy Viewer before/after diff (switchable to Raw). Lorebook entries in a multi-entry change can be **Reject**ed one at a time while the rest stays applied. Character and preset edits offer **View as prompt** (a synthetic preview, not the live chat prompt). A card left unanswered closes after 14 days and keeps the change. A no-op edit makes no card (v2.5.0, #6842). Point to references/architecture.md.

title: Character-ID macro heading says 'narrowed' in v2.5.0; #6956 actually widened name resolution
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:136 "### Character-ID macros (v2.4.0, #4336; narrowed in v2.5.0, #6956)"
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:167 (#6956): '{{<character ID>}} macros now become the character's name in Conversation and Game chats, and in Roleplay chats without a preset, instead of staying as raw text'. So those chats never received card context: before v2.5.0 the raw {{ID}} reached the model. :188 (#6924): it also resolves when the character is already in the chat. v2.5.0 took nothing away from any mode.
fix: Retitle the heading '(v2.4.0, #4336; name resolution extended in v2.5.0, #6956/#6924)'. In the Conversation/Game/preset-less bullet (line 147), add: 'before v2.5.0 the raw {{ID}} text reached the model in these chats'.

title: Convo profile text lists VN as a chat mode
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:116 "are **Conversation-mode only** — they're never sent in Roleplay / VN / Game mode"
reality: chatModeSchema has exactly conversation/roleplay/game (CANONICAL-FACTS). The VN chat mode was retired in v2.4.0 (#4368). Visual Novel is now a Roleplay display style (2.4.6, #6044; CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:979: 'Choose Classic or Visual Novel during setup or in Appearance → Roleplay').
fix: Change line 116 to 'they're never sent in Roleplay (Classic or Visual Novel display) or Game mode'.

title: Weekly schedule cross-chat sharing tagged to v2.5.0 only; Schedule Manager not pointed to
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:122 "**(v2.5.0, #6481/#6477)** it is **owned by the character** and shared by every Conversation chat they're in; individual chats can switch schedules off in Chat Settings"
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:1475 (2.4.4, #5358): 'Conversation schedules and manual status overrides now apply consistently across all chats for the same character, with per-chat schedule opt-outs still supported'. :634 (2.5.0, #6481/#6477) adds reuse of character-owned schedules, no generation when schedules are enabled, and opt-in per-character weekly renewal. :994-1007 (2.4.6) adds the Character Schedule Manager. references/architecture.md:145 already tags this '(v2.4.4–2.5.0, #5358/#6481)' and covers the manager, so the two files disagree on the version.
fix: Retag line 122: shared across all of a character's chats with per-chat opt-outs (v2.4.4, #5358); character-owned schedule reuse, no generation on enable, and opt-in weekly renewal (v2.5.0, #6481/#6477). Add: 'bulk-generate, remove or set renewal in the **Character Schedule Manager** (calendar icon beside the Conversation activity field, v2.4.6); see architecture.md'.

title: Sprite System omits full-body matched generation flow and 'Only show active sprites'
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:352 "The Expression Engine agent picks the matching sprite per message. There's also an automated sprite generation feature (uses image gen + a pose prompt) introduced in recent versions."
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:493 (2.5.0, #6611): the Expression Engine has an optional **Only show active sprites** toggle that keeps current sprites visible while expressions generate, then shows only enabled characters from the result (en.json:5748). :229 (#6872): merged Roleplay groups update expressions for the active, selected cast. :1417 (2.4.4, #5497): matched full-body sprite generation does the neutral pose first, waits for approval, then generates each expression as its own sequential request and keeps completed sprites if a later one fails or is cancelled. docs/characters/sprites.md:22,69,82: Facial Expressions / Full-body categories, Generate Sprite with source Expressions (Portrait) or Full-body, and 'Match existing expression sprites'.
fix: Replace 'introduced in recent versions' with: Sprites tab has **Facial Expressions** and **Full-body** categories. **Generate Sprite** can create either, and full-body can **Match existing expression sprites**: neutral first, then each expression in turn after approval (v2.4.4, #5497). Add Roleplay's **Only show active sprites** toggle (v2.5.0, #6611).

title: Scene setup persona choice missing from persona-selection surfaces

reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:560 (2.5.0, #6542): 'Scene setup lets you choose its persona and Conversation characters'. en.json:2587 has 'Scene persona' and en.json:2591 has 'Use the Conversation persona'.
fix: Line 108: add 'or, for a /scene, Scene setup's **Scene persona** (defaults to **Use the Conversation persona**; v2.5.0, #6542)' to the list of places a chat's persona is chosen.
